contract: Tenant and scope, navigation, account menu
acceptance: Current context is always visible; tenant switch clears old state.

contract: Sort, cursor paging, row selection and bulk actions
acceptance: Keyboard-accessible headers; hidden totals omitted; selected count is explicit.

contract: Typed filter terms and saved views
acceptance: No match differs from no data; changing scope resets incompatible filters.

contract: Title, revision, owner, lifecycle and permitted actions
acceptance: Status text is explicit; stale revisions cannot be silently acted upon.

contract: Label, unit, requiredness, hint and error
acceptance: Linked error summary; correct input type and no placeholder-only labels.

contract: Canonical decimal string and locale display
acceptance: No float coercion; missing and zero remain distinct.

contract: Source zone, reporting zone and interval
acceptance: Exclusive end semantics; retain zone and reject ambiguous parsing.

contract: Stable choice codes and row IDs
acceptance: Accessible add/remove, bounded repeat count, row error summary.

contract: Progress, per-part receipt, manifest and scan state
acceptance: Transfer completion is distinct from CLEAN; resume queries server receipts.

contract: Local draft, pending server confirmation and receipt
acceptance: Never show server success from a local write or lost response.

contract: Base, candidate and current permitted fields
acceptance: No hidden field leaks; changed candidate invalidates confirmation.

contract: Candidate, evidence, author conflict and decisions
acceptance: Independent identity and current authority; reasons and audit receipt.

contract: Value state, unit, approval, freshness and coverage
acceptance: Suppression hides raw payload; chart has a data equivalent.

contract: Included/excluded sources and rule version
acceptance: Scope-safe traversal; clear contribution identity and exclusion reason.

contract: Stage, known denominator, outcomes and cancellation
acceptance: No invented percent when total unknown; committed items remain visible.

contract: Exact scope, version, effect and recovery
acceptance: Focus trap and return; pending action preserves operation identity.

contract: Safe reference, event class, due date and read state
acceptance: Current authority checked on open; no sensitive email content by default.

contract: Safe message, correlation reference and recovery
acceptance: Retain safe drafts; never show stack traces, raw queries or tokens.

contract: Sources, exact diff, expiry and confirmation
acceptance: Target/source changes invalidate proposal; only typed draft effects.

contract: Device authority, trusted expiry and last sync
acceptance: Locked state is enforceable; stale identity or time trust is explicit.

contract: Audience, purpose, cell suppression and expiry
acceptance: Prior slices considered; approval version and download rights are fixed.

contract: Typed bindings, axes, legend, filters and table
acceptance: Colour is supplementary; suppressed data absent from every representation.
